settings.title: Measured in outcomes,
settings.intro: We track the same thing you do: whether technology is making your business faster, safer, and more profitable.

settings.title: One partner for your
settings.intro: From a single audit to full managed operations, Cobalt meets you where you are and scales with you as you grow.

design.title: IT strategy & roadmaps
design.text: A 12–18 month technology plan aligned to your business goals, with clear priorities, budgets, and a realistic timeline. No jargon, just decisions you can act on.

design.title: Cloud migration
design.text: Move to AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud on a plan that minimises downtime and risk. We right-size your estate so you only pay for what you use.

build.title: Infrastructure & networking
build.text: Design and build secure, resilient networks and server estates that scale. We document everything, so nothing lives in one person's head.

build.title: Cybersecurity hardening
build.text: Assess, remediate, and monitor. We close the gaps attackers exploit — MFA, patching, backups, and incident response — before they become headlines.

launch.title: Managed IT operations
launch.text: 24/7 monitoring, proactive maintenance, and a named support team. Your systems stay up, patched, and fast — without you managing a vendor.

launch.title: Vendor & procurement
launch.text: We negotiate, compare, and manage your software and hardware vendors so you get fair pricing and contracts that actually protect you.

settings.title: A process built on
settings.intro: No black boxes, no bait-and-switch. Here's how a typical engagement runs from first call to lasting value.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: We interview your team, review your stack, and map your current state. You get a written findings report — whether or not you hire us.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: We turn findings into a prioritised roadmap with costs, timelines, and expected ROI. You approve every phase before we start.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: Our senior consultants implement in short, visible increments. You see progress weekly, not in a big-bang reveal at the end.

steps.title: Operate
steps.text: We hand over clean documentation and, if you want, keep running it. Either way, you own the knowledge and the systems.

settings.note: Every engagement includes a written handover. We leave you more capable, not more dependent on us.

settings.title: The partner you can
settings.intro: Plenty of firms can sell you a project. We're built to be the technology partner you keep for years — and here's what that looks like in practice.

features.title: Truly independent
features.text: We don't resell hardware, software, or cloud credits. Our advice is based on what's right for you, not on our commission.

features.title: Senior people, always
features.text: The consultant who scopes your project is the one who delivers it. No bait-and-switch to juniors after the contract is signed.

features.title: Fixed, honest pricing
features.text: Fixed-scope engagements with clear deliverables. If the scope changes, we tell you before we spend a dollar — not after.

features.title: Security by default
features.text: Every system we touch gets MFA, patching, backups, and monitoring as standard. Security isn't an add-on, it's the baseline.

features.title: Documentation you own
features.text: Every engagement ends with clean, current documentation. You're never held hostage by a single vendor or a single person.

features.title: Measured ROI
features.text: We agree success metrics up front and report against them. If we can't show value, we tell you — and we fix it.

settings.title: Questions clients
settings.intro: Straight answers about independence, pricing, and what working with Cobalt actually looks like.

items.question: Are you really independent of vendors?
items.answer: Yes. We don't resell hardware, software, or cloud credits, and we don't take referral commissions. Our recommendations are based solely on what fits your business, budget, and risk profile.

items.question: How do you price your work?
items.answer: Most engagements are fixed-scope with a clear price and defined deliverables. We agree success metrics up front and report against them. If scope changes, we flag it before spending a dollar.

items.question: What size companies do you work with?
items.answer: We focus on mid-market companies — typically 50 to 1,000 employees — across manufacturing, logistics, retail, and professional services. We're big enough to handle complex estates, small enough to care.

items.question: Do we have to move to the cloud?
items.answer: No. We recommend cloud where it genuinely saves money or reduces risk, but we're equally comfortable optimising on-premises estates. The right answer depends on your situation, not our agenda.

items.question: What happens after the project ends?
items.answer: You get clean documentation and full ownership of your systems. If you'd like, we can also run ongoing managed operations. Either way, you're never locked in or left stranded.
